stories.name: Apple Foldable iPhone Launch
stories.blurb: Apple has unveiled its first foldable smartphone, the $1,999 iPhone Duo, marking its entry into the foldable market and its most expensive phone to date.

stories.name: Vanguard Growth ETF Debate
stories.blurb: A recurring theme of financial articles comparing and recommending Vanguard growth-focused ETFs (like VUG and VGT) against rivals as long-term investment options.

stories.name: Apple OpenAI trade secrets lawsuit
stories.blurb: Apple is suing OpenAI over allegations that former Apple employees took trade secrets to help build OpenAI's unreleased AI hardware device, with both sides escalating legal claims and evidence dispute

stories.name: Apple stock rally
stories.blurb: Apple shares have surged to record highs ahead of its Q3 earnings, prompting debate over whether the stock can keep climbing or is due for a pullback.

stories.name: Meta's Muse AI Surge
stories.blurb: Meta's stock rallies as its new AI app Muse gains rapid popularity, boosting investor confidence in the company's AI strategy ahead of Meta Connect.

stories.name: Tokenized Stock Trading
stories.blurb: Major financial and crypto firms are launching blockchain-based tokens of Apple, Nvidia, Tesla, and other U.S. stocks on Solana and other platforms, enabling 24/7 onchain trading of tokenized equities

past.name: iPhone 18 production cuts
past.blurb: Apple is cutting iPhone 18 Pro component orders and facing rising memory costs, pressuring its stock and pricing power.

past.name: Apple CEO transition
past.blurb: John Ternus succeeds Tim Cook as Apple CEO, raising questions about the company's future direction and leadership style.

past.name: Apple Broadcom chip deal
past.blurb: Apple has signed a multi-year, $30 billion-plus agreement with Broadcom to supply chips through 2031, boosting Broadcom's stock and expanding its Colorado plant.

past.name: Qualcomm Apple patent deal
past.blurb: Qualcomm and Apple renewed their long-term global patent licensing agreement, easing investor fears about Qualcomm's revenue but leaving questions about its growth beyond Apple.

past.name: Iran-Israel Oil Market Swings
past.blurb: Stock markets fluctuate as investors react to escalating and de-escalating US-Iran/Middle East tensions, oil price swings, and their effects on earnings, Fed policy, and economic data.

past.name: Memory Chip Shortage
past.blurb: A global surge in memory and storage chip prices is forcing Apple to raise prices on MacBooks and iPads while even considering banned Chinese chip suppliers to cope with the shortage.

8.text: Apple reportedly cut iPhone orders by up to 20% ahead of a $1,999 foldable launch, signaling possible price resistance. John Ternus became CEO, with Tim Cook moving to executive chair, and Apple named a new M&A chief.

5.text: Vanguard growth and S&P 500 ETF coverage compares fees, returns, and mega-cap tech concentration, with VUG hitting a record $92 and VGT up 3x since ChatGPT's launch. Apple is not mentioned; it bears on the story only as a top holding in these funds.

6.text: Apple is partnering with LG to co-develop smart home devices including a doorbell, lock, and thermostat, and will unveil a HomePad screen at an October 13 event. Separately, a court ordered Apple to pay $184M in interest on Masimo patent damages, and Tim Cook met China's vice premier.

7.text: Apple shares rose about 24% year-to-date to roughly $333–$340, beating the S&P 500, on strong iPhone demand, Services growth, and record quarterly revenue of $109.4 billion. Analysts debate whether the stock's 35–38x forward earnings multiple is justified ahead of October 29 earnings.

11.text: Meta's month-old Muse AI agent hit 4 million users in 10 days, with Citi projecting over $27 billion in annual revenue by 2030, while a TIME report says it builds dossiers on users and their friends. Apple is only listed among stocks in one Zacks roundup.

16.text: Securitize launched 1:1-backed tokenized Apple, Nvidia, Tesla, and nine other US stocks on Solana, sending its shares up about 10-12%. Separately, NYSE parent ICE filed for SEC-approved tokenization of 63 US stocks, including Apple, on a crypto-native exchange.

14.text: Apple reportedly asked suppliers to cut iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max component orders by at least 15%, citing softer demand and rising AI-related memory costs. Apple shares fell about 2% to 3% on the news, with supplier stocks mixed.

15.text: John Ternus, just over a month into the CEO role, named a new M&A chief, is shifting to year-round device releases, and sold $8.5 million in stock. Apple also struck a podcast deal with Huxe, faces a possible Starlink phone rival, and Tim Cook discussed a youth-focused project.
